theater: 薩莫尼亞山地與薩賓邊境

battle.name: 第三次薩莫奈戰爭
battle.theater: 薩莫尼亞山地與薩賓邊境
battle.brief: 西元前298至290年，第三次薩莫奈戰爭在薩莫尼亞山地與薩賓邊境打了八年。薩莫奈人拉上伊特魯里亞與翁布里亞聯軍，一度夜襲奪走羅馬營地；西元前295年森提努斯之戰，羅馬靠縱隊集中與兩翼騎兵反敗為勝，聯軍自此崩解。卡面的希臘重步兵站在聯軍與羅馬盟邦的方陣中，是整場戰爭的重裝骨幹。

kit.name: 希臘重步兵
kit.history: 方陣的重心不是個人，是互相遮蔽。盾牌接在一起時，一支軍隊的正面比一個人結實。

countries: 第三次薩莫奈戰爭於西元前298年至290年在義大利中部展開，主戰場是薩莫尼亞的山地、薩賓與埃特魯里亞南緣，以及坎帕尼亞北部的塞拉諾河與利里河上游。羅馬一方由兩名執政官各帶一邊人馬，核心是公民兵與盟邦兵混編的縱隊：Hastati 與 Principes 兩列重裝步兵、擔任散兵的 Veleites、資深的第三線老兵，加上拉提姆同盟、赫爾尼基人、坎帕尼亞人、沃爾斯基人等盟邦的方陣兵與騎兵，軍中也有大量希臘與南義大利的僱傭重裝步兵。薩莫奈一方是四部族（彭特里、希爾皮尼、考迪尼、西迪奇尼）組成的聯盟，加上伊特魯里亞城邦聯盟與翁布里亞人，並有馬西人、佩利尼人、馬魯奇尼人等奧斯卡族小部族隨軍，構成一支成分雜沓、但由薩莫奈人擔任戰術主導的聯軍。聯軍內部並不齊一：伊特魯里亞人與翁布里亞人各有自己的地盤算計，出兵多寡與撤退時機都留了餘地；薩莫奈人則想藉聯軍的規模取回西元前322年和約中被羅馬削去的自由。整場戰爭的結構，就是這支聯軍如何在山地條件下屢次挑戰羅馬的縱隊，又如何在西元前295年的森提努斯戰場上被羅馬拆散。
countriesEn: The Third Samnite War was fought from 298 to 290 BC in central Italy, with the main theatres in the mountains of Samnium, in the Sabine country and on the southern edge of Etruria, and along the upper Silarus and the Liri in northern Campania. On the Roman side two consuls each led one wing of the field army, and the core of that army was the manipular mixture of citizen and allied troops: hastati and principes in two lines of heavy infantry, velites serving out ahead as skirmishers, and the triarii in the rear, together with the phalanxes and cavalry of the Latin League, the Hernici, the Campanians and the Volsci, with a large number of Greek and South Italian mercenary hoplites also in the ranks. The Samnite side was a league of four tribes, the Pentri, Hirpini, Caudini and Sidicini, joined by the Etruscan city-states and by the Umbrians, with smaller Oscan peoples such as the Marsians, the Pelignii and the Marrucini marching in support: a coalition of mixed elements in which the Samnites held the tactical lead. That coalition was never solid. The Etruscans and the Umbrians each pursued their own territorial interest and kept their own options open about how many men to send and when to withdraw, while the Samnites wanted the weight of the alliance to win back the freedom the Romans had taken from them in the treaty of 322 BC. The whole structure of the war is that coalition challenging the Roman manipular army again and again in mountain country, and then being taken apart by the Romans on the field of Sentinum in 295 BC.
people: 這場戰爭裡留得下名字的人不多，但每一個都站在關鍵位置上。薩莫奈聯軍的指揮官蓋流斯·埃格納提烏斯是核心人物，他率領聯軍攻到羅馬的邊境，屢次在前線策動攻勢；李維把西元前321年卡烏迪納分岔口設伏的薩莫奈指揮官也記作同一個名字，通常被理解為他的父親，這對父子把薩莫奈人對羅馬的舊怨推到最高點。羅馬方面最重的一個名字是執政官昆圖斯·法比烏斯·馬克西穆斯·魯利亞努斯，他兩度出任執政官，並在西元前295年的森提努斯之戰中指揮羅馬主力，戰死陣中；同任執政官布布利烏斯·狄西烏斯·穆斯也同日陣亡，使這一役同時失去兩位最高統帥。狄西烏斯家族那套著名的「獻身」儀式，傳統上繫於西元前338年阿爾布拉河的一役，而不是森提努斯，兩件事常被混為一談。馬爾庫斯·瓦列里烏斯·馬克西穆斯在西元前296年出任獨裁官，收拾了被薩莫奈人夜襲奪去的羅馬營地；盧基烏斯·帕皮里烏斯·庫爾索在西元前293年的因布里維烏姆之戰裡，用一座假營地的火堆騙開敵營並攻入其後，贏下那一役，此人後來還在西元前219年的史書中因為縱容年輕的普布利烏斯·科爾涅利烏斯·斯基皮奧而留名。戰爭的最後一年，執政官盧基烏斯·科爾涅利烏斯·斯基皮奧與格奈烏斯·馬爾基烏斯·科里奧拉努斯面對薩莫奈使團的求和，元老院一度拒絕，最後靠公民大會的壓力才把和約定下來。
peopleEn: Few of the people involved in this war can be named, but each of them stood in a decisive position. The commander of the Samnite coalition was Gellius Egnatius, the central figure; he led the coalition up to the Roman frontier and repeatedly drove the fighting forward. Livy records the Samnite commander who laid the ambush at the Caudine Forks in 321 BC under the same name, and he is usually understood to be the elder of the two, a father and son pair who pushed the old grievance of the Samnites against Rome to its height. The heaviest name on the Roman side is Quintus Fabius Maximus Rullianus, consul twice, who commanded the main Roman army at the battle of Sentinum in 295 BC and fell in the fighting; his colleague in the consulship, Publius Decius Mus, died the same day, so that the engagement cost Rome both of its supreme commanders at once. The famous rite of self-devotion of the Decii is traditionally tied to the battle at the Albula in 338 BC, not to Sentinum, and the two are often conflated. Marcus Valerius Maximus was named dictator in 296 BC and recovered the Roman camp that the Samnites had carried off in a night attack; Lucius Papirius Cursor, in the battle of Imbrivium in 293 BC, lit the fires of a false camp to deceive the enemy and entered the real camp behind it, winning that battle, and the same man appears in the annals of 219 BC remembered for conniving at the conduct of the young Publius Cornelius Scipio. In the last year of the war the consuls Lucius Cornelius Scipio and Gnaeus Marcius Coriolanus received the Samnite envoys who came seeking peace; the Senate refused at first, and it was pressure from the assembly of the people that finally carried the treaty through.
kits: 卡面上的希臘重步兵，也就是 hoplite，是這場戰爭裡最基礎的重裝骨幹。典型裝備是直徑約九十公分的圓盾（aspis）、約兩公尺長的長矛（dory，前端為鐵或青銅的葉形矛頭，槍尾留一截可插地的尖錐）、四十至六十公分的短劍（xiphos）、帶護頰的青銅頭盔，以及護脛；胸甲有青銅的肌肉甲與亞麻加皮草製的胸甲兩種用法。方陣的原理就寫在卡面那句話裡：盾牌相接時，一支軍隊的正面比一個人結實。hoplite 的單兵作戰力並不驚人，長矛的刺擊距離短，短劍的劈砍要靠側面，頭盔的視野有限；他的價值全在於站進那個互相遮蔽的集體，由兩翼的同袍替他擋走側面的刀口。在第三次薩莫奈戰爭裡，希臘式重裝步兵同時出現在兩邊：羅馬與其盟邦的軍隊裡有大量希臘與南義大利的僱傭方陣兵，仍用圓盾、長矛與短劍；而薩莫奈與伊特魯里亞聯軍的步兵則已改用義大利式裝備，即寬約一公尺的大弧盾（scutum Samniticum）、四十至五十公分的單刃短劍（gladius Samniticus）、約二點四公尺的長矛（hasta Samnitica），胸甲是兩三片青銅圓盤拼成的薩莫奈圓盤甲。這套薩莫奈式裝備後來被羅馬吸納，成為羅馬第四世紀末以後的制式：大弧盾成為羅馬大盾，長矛演化成重標槍 pilum，gladius Samniticus 演化成羅馬短劍 gladius Italicus。羅馬步兵另配約二公尺的 pilum，遠程齊射是縱隊制打法的開端；騎兵方面，薩莫奈騎兵按波里比烏斯記載仍穿薩莫奈式裝具，羅馬盟邦的騎兵則以達爾馬提亞與伊利里亞系的輕騎散兵為主。攻城與野營器具方面，羅馬軍靠營柵與帳幕宿營，取山區據點時備有撞錘與雲梯。
kitsEn: The Greek heavy infantry on the card face, the hoplite, is the basic heavy backbone of this war. The typical equipment is a round shield of about ninety centimetres in diameter (aspis), a spear about two metres long (dory, with an iron or bronze leaf-shaped head at the front and a spike left at the butt for planting in the ground), a short sword of forty to sixty centimetres (xiphos), a bronze helmet with cheek pieces, and greaves; for the body there were either a bronze muscle cuirass or a corselet of linen and leather. The principle of the phalanx is the sentence on the card itself: when shields are set side by side, the front of an army is tougher than a single man. A hoplite's individual fighting power was not remarkable; his spear had a short reach, his sword needed the flank to swing, his helmet restricted his view, and his whole value lay in standing inside a mutually sheltering body, with the men on his flanks taking the knife-edge away from his side. In the Third Samnite War the Greek-style heavy infantry stood on both sides: the Roman and allied armies contained large numbers of Greek and South Italian mercenary phalanx soldiers who still carried the round shield, the spear and the short sword, while the infantry of the Samnite and Etruscan coalition had already taken up the Italic equipment, that is the large curved scutum Samniticum about a metre wide, the single-edged gladius Samniticus of forty to fifty centimetres, the hasta Samnitica of about two and a half metres, and a cuirass of two or three bronze discs known as the Samnite disc cuirass. That Samnite equipment was later absorbed by the Romans and became their standard from the late fourth century: the curved shield became the Roman scutum, the spear evolved into the heavy javelin, the pilum, and the gladius Samniticus into the Roman gladius Italicus. The Roman infantry carried a pilum of about two metres besides, and the volley of javelins was the opening move of manipular fighting. On the cavalry side the Samnite horsemen still wore the Samnite panoply according to Polybius, while the Roman allied horse were light skirmishers drawn mainly from the Dalmatian and Illyrian peoples. For siege and camp work the Roman army relied on its palisade and tent lines, and brought rams and ladders against the hill towns.
tactics: 雙方的打法在這八年間不斷互相修正。薩莫奈與聯軍的戰術核心是熟悉山地的設伏與佯動：西元前298年的首戰，聯軍在崎嶇谷地引羅馬縱隊入險，李維記下羅馬軍一度被壓得節節後退，靠前列士兵的挺槍與盾牆才穩住陣腳；西元前296年羅馬營地被奪，靠的也是聯軍利用羅馬主力離營、夜間強襲的空隙。伊特魯里亞與翁布里亞的輕兵專職擾亂與破壞糧道，把羅馬縱隊拉成細長的隊形，強迫它們在無法展開的隘口作戰。羅馬這邊靠縱隊的彈性應對：十個大隊不必同時接戰，可在需要的地方把大隊合成重兵，即所謂集中大隊，前線以盾牆頂住，後方散兵與 hastati 以標槍齊射削弱敵陣；兩翼由盟邦騎兵壓住對方兩翼，關鍵時刻以整個縱隊的騎兵衝鋒扭轉戰局。森提努斯之戰裡，狄奧尼修斯記載羅馬軍採用凹形新月陣，兩翼向後彎，正面留給下坡的聯軍，中央以步兵縱隊頂住，兩翼騎兵同時壓上，等於把「方陣正面很結實」改成「正面不吃衝鋒」。攻營地的手段也在同一期間成熟：西元前293年帕皮里烏斯·庫爾索先在別處點起一堆仿營地的火，只留少數人守住，再趁夜色偷襲真正的薩莫奈營寨並取之，一舉扭轉戰局。羅馬的後勤靠每季轉役的公民徵召與盟邦分攤，配給與糧秣按軍團供應，宿營依營柵法規在方圓約兩百公尺的營地內展開。
tacticsEn: Both sides corrected each other's methods again and again during those eight years. The core of Samnite and coalition tactics was ambush and feigned movement in country they knew: in the opening battle of 298 BC the coalition drew the Roman manipul into broken ground, and Livy records the Roman army being pressed back step by step and steadied only by the thrust of the spears and the shield wall of the leading files; the Roman camp lost in 296 BC came the same way, with the coalition striking at night while the main Roman force was away from it. Etruscan and Umbrian light troops were employed on harassment and on cutting supply, drawing the Roman column out into a long thin order and forcing it to fight in defiles where it could not deploy. Rome answered with the elasticity of the manipular system: the ten maniples did not have to engage all at once, and could be concentrated into a heavy force where it was needed, the front holding with a shield wall while velites and hastati in the rear weakened the enemy line with volleys of javelins; the allied cavalry on the wings held the enemy's flanks, and at the decisive moment a charge by the cavalry of the whole column turned the action. At Sentinum Dionysius describes the Roman army in a hollow crescent, the two wings bent back, the front left to the coalition coming down the slope, the centre of the Roman infantry order holding the line while the horse pressed on both wings at once, which amounts to changing the principle that a phalanx front is strong into the principle that a phalanx front does not take a charge. The means of storming a camp matured in the same period: in 293 BC Papirius Cursor had fires laid in a mimic camp elsewhere, with only a few men left to keep them, and then attacked the real Samnite camp by night and took it, reversing the situation in one stroke. On the Roman side logistics rested on the season's levy of citizens and on the allies' contributions, with rations and baggage supplied by the army units, and the camp laid out by the rules of the palisade inside a square of roughly two hundred metres on a side.
data: 可核的數字不多，但幾個節點站得住。戰爭本身：西元前298年開打，西元前290年訂約，前後約八年；期間的主要會戰有西元前295年的森提努斯之戰、西元前293年的因布里維烏姆之戰，最後一年的攻勢落在莫利塞的山城博維亞努姆。編年家狄奧尼修斯為森提努斯兩軍各記下數萬人級別的兵力，羅馬方面的總數常被引述為七萬上下，但這類數字出自戰後數百年的追述，與李維的記載互相矛盾，只能當作量級參考。狄奧尼修斯也留下制度性數字：羅馬每側軍由兩個軍團組成，軍團下轄十個步兵大隊，每個大隊約四百二十人，另配騎兵六百；這套編制寫的是西元前250年前後的縱隊，比本戰爭晚半個世紀，用來看兵員結構可以，用來當作森提努斯的點名冊則不可。兵器尺度：hoplite 圓盾直徑約九十公分，連青銅盾面重約六七公斤；長矛約兩公尺；薩莫奈式大弧盾寬約一公尺，短劍四十至五十公分，長矛約二點四公尺；羅馬重標槍 pilum 約二公尺，第四世紀末的羅馬大盾長約一點二公尺。營地方面，羅馬軍隊的野營營地約兩百公尺見方，前區為帳幕，中區為帳房，後區為騎兵與糧秣區。損失方面沒有可靠數字，只能說西元前295年一役羅馬陣亡兩名執政官與大批軍官，聯軍中伊特魯里亞與翁布里亞兩部分未戰先退；西元前296年羅馬營地被奪時被俘的士兵，李維記為數千之眾。
dataEn: Few of the numbers can be checked, but several fixed points hold. The war itself: it opened in 298 BC and was settled by treaty in 290 BC, eight years in all; the principal engagements were the battle of Sentinum in 295 BC and the battle of Imbrivium in 293 BC, with the campaign of the last year falling on the hill town of Bovianum in Molise. The chronicler Dionysius gives both armies at Sentinum a strength of tens of thousands, and the Roman total is commonly quoted at around seventy thousand, but such figures come from a recollection written centuries after the event and contradict Livy's account, so they can only be used as an order of magnitude. Dionysius also leaves institutional figures: on each side of the Roman field army were two legions, each legion divided into ten maniples of about four hundred and twenty men, with six hundred horse; this establishment describes the manipular army of about 250 BC, half a century later than this war, so it serves for the structure of the forces but not as a roll call for Sentinum. On the scale of the arms: the hoplite's round shield was about ninety centimetres in diameter and weighed some six or seven kilograms with its bronze facing; the spear was about two metres; the Samnite curved shield was about a metre wide, the short sword forty to fifty centimetres, the spear about two and a half metres; the Roman heavy javelin, the pilum, was about two metres, and the Roman scutum of the late fourth century was about a metre and a fifth long. On the camp: the Roman marching camp was a square of roughly two hundred metres on a side, with the commander's tent in front, the tent lines in the middle, and the horse and baggage at the rear. On losses there are no reliable figures; it can only be said that in 295 BC Rome lost two consuls and many officers at Sentinum, that the Etruscan and Umbrian parts of the coalition left the field before the fighting was decided, and that when the Roman camp was carried in 296 BC Livy records thousands of Roman soldiers taken prisoner.
cause: 打起來有四層原因。第一層是西元前322年第二次薩莫奈戰爭結束時羅馬強加的和約：那條和約把薩莫奈人壓得極慘，規定各部族不得合議、不得互派代表，軍事上限制他們常備的人數，並把首長人選的審核權交給羅馬執政官，薩莫尼亞還要交出人質。羅馬把這份條約視為終局，薩莫奈人卻把它視為屈辱；二十年後的第三代領袖蓋流斯·埃格納提烏斯一出現，就以推翻這些條款為目標。第二層是薩莫奈本身的實力回升：西元前331年亞歷山大一世以來的南義大利與希臘世界長期動盪，讓山區的薩莫奈人得以擴兵、取得金屬原料與招募同盟，聯軍的首腦蓋流斯正是靠這批資源在山中拉起數萬人。第三層是外族的恐懼：伊特魯里亞城邦害怕羅馬把勢力伸進波河平原，翁布里亞人擔心被打出中部丘陵，兩者因此願意出兵，但都把撤退時機留給自己。第四層是舊怨與新仇：卡烏迪納分岔口的慘敗與西元前321年後那一份屈辱和約仍被人記著，而羅馬在義大利南部對塔蘭托與圖里伊的作為，又給聯軍添了一層正當性。
causeEn: There were four layers of reason behind the fighting. The first is the treaty Rome imposed at the end of the Second Samnite War in 322 BC: a settlement that pressed the Samnites extremely hard, forbidding the tribes to hold joint councils or to send delegates to one another, limiting the size of the force they might keep under arms, handing the vetting of their leaders over to the Roman consuls, and requiring hostages from Samnium. Rome treated that settlement as the end of the matter; the Samnites treated it as an humiliation, and when a third generation of leaders appeared in the person of Gellius Egnatius two decades later, overturning those clauses became his stated purpose. The second layer is the recovery of Samnite strength: the long disorder in southern Italy and the Greek world from Alexander the Great's crossing in 331 BC allowed the mountain Samnites to expand their levy, come by metal and recruit allies, and it was on exactly those resources that Gellius raised tens of thousands in the hills. The third layer is the fear of the other peoples: the Etruscan city-states were afraid of Rome pushing its power into the Po plain, and the Umbrians of being driven out of the central hills, so both sent men but kept the moment of withdrawal in their own hands. The fourth layer is old grudge and new grievance: the defeat at the Caudine Forks and the humiliating peace of 321 BC were still remembered, while Rome's conduct in southern Italy against Tarentum and Thurii gave the coalition a further claim to legitimacy.
impact: 打完這場戰爭，義大利中部的權力結構被徹底改寫。薩莫奈聯盟作為一個能拉出數萬人作戰的政治單位從此瓦解，各部族被要求解散同盟、不得再議，薩莫尼亞以屬地的形式被羅馬編入勢力範圍，兵員上限與首長人選仍由羅馬監督，山區的要塞也一落到羅馬手裡。伊特魯里亞與翁布里亞沒有被打垮，但從此再沒有獨力對抗羅馬的意願。拉丁同盟對羅馬的依賴加深，羅馬得以用戰勝者身分接管盟邦的行政與軍籍，最後走向西元前340至338年的拉丁戰爭，統一拉丁平原。軍事技術上，薩莫奈式裝備被羅馬吸納並標準化：大弧盾成為羅馬大盾，薩莫奈長矛演化為重標槍，短劍演化成 gladius Italicus，羅馬步兵自此有了自己一套穩定而強悍的裝備系統。有學者把縱隊中「集中大隊」的改革繫於這幾年，因為連續八年的遠征暴露了傳統徵召制的極限，而西元前三一零年代把執政官選舉交給百人團大會的奧維尼亞法，正是長期徵召壓力下的制度調整。這場勝利還把羅馬推到義大利南部的前沿，直接刺激塔蘭托在幾年後向伊庇魯斯王皮洛士求援，拉開了羅馬與希臘世界直接交手的序章。
impactEn: When the war was over the structure of power in central Italy had been rewritten. The Samnite league, as a political unit able to put tens of thousands into the field, was broken up: the tribes were required to dissolve their league and to meet no more, Samnium was drawn into Rome's sphere as a province, the ceiling on their levy and the vetting of their leaders remained in Roman hands, and the forts of the mountains passed to Rome one after another. Etruria and Umbria were not beaten down, but from then on neither showed any wish to stand alone against Rome. The Latin League grew more dependent on Rome, and Rome was able as victor to take over the administration and the military rolls of its allies, a road that ran on to the Latin War of 340 to 338 BC and the union of the Latin plain. In military terms the Samnite equipment was absorbed and standardised by Rome: the curved shield became the Roman scutum, the Samnite spear evolved into the heavy javelin, the short sword into the gladius Italicus, and the Roman infantry from that point on had a stable and formidable system of its own. Some scholars tie the reform of the manipular system that concentrated maniples to these very years, because eight consecutive campaigns of long service exposed the limits of the old levy, and the law of the late fourth century that handed the election of consuls to the centuriate assembly was itself a constitutional adjustment made under the pressure of that repeated levying. The victory also carried Rome to the front line of southern Italy and directly goaded Tarentum into calling on Pyrrhus of Epirus a few years later, opening the prelude to a direct meeting between Rome and the Greek world.
result: 西元前290年，戰爭以和約收場。薩莫奈人先遣使團到羅馬求和，元老院一度拒絕，主戰派不願放棄已經到手的優勢；最後是執政官盧基烏斯·科爾涅利烏斯·斯基皮奧與格奈烏斯·馬爾基烏斯·科里奧拉努斯把事情推上公民大會，讓選民聽到薩莫奈人的條件並把兩人推選為下一年執政官，元老院才讓步。條款大意是：薩莫奈人歸還俘虜、交出人質、賠償損失並解散聯盟，羅馬則確認對薩莫尼亞的監督權。軍事層面上，結果早就寫在森提努斯：西元前295年聯軍總指揮蓋流斯·埃格納提烏斯陣亡，兩名羅馬執政官同日陣亡，但聯軍中伊特魯里亞與翁布里亞的部分離陣返鄉，薩莫奈人被迫獨自面對羅馬的縱隊與盟邦騎兵，此後再無翻盤的機會；西元前293年因布里維烏姆之戰中帕皮里烏斯·庫爾索夜取薩莫奈營寨，羅馬的戰略主動權再沒有丟過；西元前290年羅馬攻取莫利塞的山城博維亞努姆，薩莫奈人失去最後的抵抗中心，聯盟正式解體。這場勝利沒有讓羅馬立刻成為地中海強權，但把它變成義大利中部無爭議的主人；而西元前280年皮洛士率軍渡海而來時，羅馬已經握有一支經過八年山地戰錘煉的軍隊，也已經被捲進南義大利的戰場。
resultEn: The war ended in a treaty in 290 BC. The Samnites sent an embassy to Rome to ask for peace; the Senate refused at first, the party that wanted the war unwilling to give up the advantage already gained. In the end the consuls Lucius Cornelius Scipio and Gnaeus Marcius Coriolanus carried the matter before the assembly of the people, let the voters hear the Samnite terms and returned the two men to the consulship for the following year, and only then did the Senate give way. The substance of the terms was that the Samnites should return their prisoners, give hostages, make compensation and dissolve their league, while Rome confirmed its right to supervise Samnium. At the military level the result had been written at Sentinum long before: in 295 BC the commander of the coalition, Gellius Egnatius, was killed, and two Roman consuls died on the same day, but the Etruscan and Umbrian parts of the coalition left the field and went home, and the Samnites were left alone against the Roman manipular army and the allied horse with no further chance to turn the war; in 293 BC at Imbrivium Papirius Cursor took the Samnite camp by night, and Rome never again lost the strategic initiative; in 290 BC the Romans took the hill town of Bovianum in Molise, the Samnites lost their last centre of resistance, and the league came formally apart. The victory did not make Rome a Mediterranean power overnight, but it made Rome the unquestioned master of central Italy; and when Pyrrhus crossed the sea in 280 BC, Rome already held an army tempered by eight years of mountain war and had already been drawn into the fighting in southern Italy.
